h1check.label: SIM: sim2 (H1 hand, H1 contact law, dynamic nose + refill) against H1 (opt.inertial.evaluate) on H1's own test scenarios; published = results/opt/inertial_opt.json rev_h_B_table (means over seeds 200-203)

diagnose.label: SIM: the largest sim2-H1 differences of stage h1check (r_rot 0.5): oracle cases rerun with idealised nose actuators (every-step servo, no Hall delay, no coil lag; 400 Hz and 2 kHz inner loops), causal cases rerun with five sensor-noise seeds in both models

streams.label: SIM: the causal tracker's input streams of both models on the case with the largest causal difference (test seed 200, 8 Hz, 2 mm), and the AKF's settled frequency per sensor-noise seed

attrib.label: SIM: worst oracle cases of h1check (r_rot 0.5, test seeds) with a 0.45 N refill spring and with a 10x lighter nose and refill

contact.label: SIM: MuJoCo 3.6 soft contacts and the H1 contact law (verify.py)

convergence.label: SIM: Rev H case (H1 hand, H1 contact law unless stated), training seed 300, 8 Hz 1 mm, first 3 s; ink path difference against the finest step

energy.label: SIM: pen in the air, H1 hand springs as joint springs (verify.energy_audit)

gyro.label: SIM: 18.1 g rotor (16 x 5 mm WHA) on a driven gimbal; reaction torque against h x omega

imu.note: pen held still on the paper; 20-200 Hz band; 'raw' = accelerometer reading rotated to the page (fusion's reading model: its noise density should come back); 'compensated' adds the firmware's lever-arm term r x d(omega)/dt, which differentiates gyro noise (dominant above ~50 Hz)

sensors.label: SIM: sensor models (sensors.py) against fusion.sensors and MuJoCo's native accelerometer

native.label: SIM: Rev H-B, H1 hand, training seeds; mujoco = native soft contact at the default setting (solref 2 ms, solimp 0.95/0.99, impratio 1, elliptic); mujoco_stiff = solref 0.5 ms, solimp 0.99/0.999, impratio 10

frontstop.label: SIM: Rev H-B with the H1 hand; nose_adaptive = stop follows the nose deflection (0.3 mm margin), carrier = fixed 0.3 mm beyond contact, wide = 0.3 mm + stop travel x cot(theta)

meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (simulator v2, MuJoCo 3.6; synthetic writing and tremor; nothing measured)
